content: Room: exportSchema must be true with room.schemaLocation KSP arg from v1 or auto-migrations impossible and migration tests have no baseline; fallbackToDestructiveMigration wipes user data on missing path; missing path throws IllegalStateException at open; ambiguous renames/deletes need AutoMigrationSpec; main-thread queries throw unless allowMainThreadQueries (never enable); MigrationTestHelper needs exported schemas in androidTest assets.
